title: A new web-research skill joins the toolbox
summary:
A maintenance-minded day: a new research skill, steadier account handling, fresher community updates, and better operational visibility.

Added a web-research skill, giving agents another way to gather context before they start confidently inventing it.

Tier management moved to D1, Polar was simplified to webhook-only handling, and a problematic balance-reset cron was disabled so account balances stay more dependable.

Four new community highlights landed alongside a README news update, making recent projects and platform changes easier to find.
